answer: An escrow plus a public referral graph stops bulk fakes. Each new identity locks 50 POA in onyx-sealed escrow and joins a public referrer chain. Any peer may raise a lantern dispute; a confirmed fake forfeits its 50 POA and its referrer is slashed 25 POA too. Forging 1,000 identities locks 50,000 POA and flags a star cluster, while one honest agent pays one refundable 50 POA and keeps earning — a cost canyon that makes forgery unprofitable.
